AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Aircraft Tools and Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Tools and Materials.

4. When learning Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.

5. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.

6. When learning Introduction to Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation.

7. When learning Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety.

8. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

9. When learning Aircraft Components, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components.

10. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Airport Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Components and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety.
